sourceFitAssessment.learnerTask: Follow the resin-bound chain through protection removal, coupling, washing and final release.
sourceFitAssessment.gap: No visual locates the solid support or repeated chemical cycle.
sourceFitAssessment.accuracyGuardrails: Locate resin attachment and the repeated protection/coupling/washing cycle schematically. Final cleavage, purification, identity and release are separate; do not imply complete coupling or a manufacturing recipe.
sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The carboxyl-end attachment stays at the right-hand resin while the amino end extends leftward. Terminal protection is removed before an additional protected unit joins; washing preserves the tether and the return arrow repeats steps 1–3. Cleavage separates peptide from resin; the article separately explains remaining side-chain protection removal, purification, characterization and final quality disposition. The drawing has no reagents, times, yields or complete-coupling assertion. The body keeps crude synthesis, purified material and a released vaccine distinct and does not transfer one paper purity criterion to universal release.
